memory.auto_description: Recent lines written directly because their confidence is above the threshold. If one is wrong, use "Undo" on its row; if the rule is wrong, remove it under "Active rules".
memory.error_UNSUPPORTED_FILE: The file could not be read. Export it from Luca as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV; legacy .xls is not supported.
memory.error_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (10 MB at most).
